message: A ceiling—
It was an unfamiliar ceiling.
When I opened my eyes, that was all I could see.
Not my house. Not the barracks. Not the academy either.
Where am I—
I reflexively tried to move my body, but it wouldn't budge an inch. It wasn't sleep paralysis. Something was pinning me down with sheer force.
There was no mistaking the sense of danger I felt. However, a voice cut in on my panic. A familiar voice—

name: Asahi
message: 「Ahh, Iori-san's sleeping face...！ I have to take plenty of pictures of this...！！」
Kuki Asahi.
She's here, and I can't move. And she doesn't look panicked at all—in fact, she seems to be enjoying herself.
Which means...

name: Iori
message: 「Wait... have I been held captive？！」
I desperately tried to move my head in a panic. And then—

name: Asahi
message: 「Held captive？ Whatever are you talking about, Iori-san？」
Looking completely bewildered, Asahi peered down into my face.

name: Asahi
message: 「Good morning, Iori-san. Did you sleep well？」
Instead of her usual uniform, Asahi was wearing casual clothes I still wasn't quite used to seeing. The sight jogged my memory all at once.

name: Iori
message: 「...Right. I'm not being held captive.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Of course not. I would never do something like that today. After all—」

name: Asahi
message: 「We finally came on a trip together, just the two of us, Iori-san！」
Seeing Asahi's eyes sparkling with joy, I decided to set aside the various doubts popping into my head for now—like, 'Wait, so you WOULD hold me captive on any other day？'

name: Iori
message: （That's right, the two of us came on a trip）
I knew why Asahi was looking so happy. It wasn't just because she was always like this.
This trip was Asahi's―no, it was fair to call it our long―cherished wish.
When was that, again?
If I tried to trace it back, I felt like I could go back endlessly. After all, you could even say it started the moment Asahi and I met.
Still, I suppose it's best to say it started right after the Martial Festival ended—

name: Asahi
message: 「Sigh...」

name: Iori
message: 「So this is where you were, Asahi.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Ah, Iori-sensei... Were you looking for me？」

name: Iori
message: 「Well... something like that.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Hehe, that makes me happy. Thank you.」
Even as she said that, Asahi didn't pounce on me or launch into any of her usual passionate leaps of fancy.
...Which meant she really was that disappointed, huh.

name: Iori
message: "Is it about the Martial Festival after all?"

name: Asahi
message: 「……Iori-sensei can see right through my heart, huh. I actually like that side of you, though」

name: Iori
message: "I think it was a great match. I'm not just trying to console you—you really had a solid shot at winning, Asahi."

name: Asahi
message: "Thank you. Even so... in the end, I lost. Failing to turn that chance into victory was my own weakness."

name: Iori
message: 「Asahi……」

name: Asahi
message: "No, I'm not being self-deprecating. I'm simply, genuinely frustrated."

name: Asahi
message: "More than simply losing, I can't stand that I lost even after receiving your guidance, Iori-sensei."

name: Asahi
message: "And to lose to someone else who was also taught by you, Iori-sensei..."

name: Asahi
message: "I truly believed I had turned your teachings into strength better than anyone else...!"

name: Asahi
message: "Feeling like I lost even on that front makes it all the more frustrating!"

name: Iori
message: "You don't need to worry about that—as far as I'm concerned, every one of you gave it 100%."

name: Asahi
message: "I gave it 120%!"
She seems to be getting her usual spirit back.

name: Iori
message: "Either way, it's only natural to feel frustrated after a loss. Hold onto that frustration and carry it into your next match."

name: Iori
message: "There's no question you've gotten stronger too, Asahi. You still have a long way to climb."

name: Asahi
message: "...You're right. And unlike back then, I have you by my side now, Iori-sensei."

name: Asahi
message: "With your guidance—no, with your love, Iori-sensei—I'll grow stronger without limit!"

name: Iori
message: 「Love……！？」

name: Asahi
message: "Not just with your hands, either—with my feet, my head, my waist... have you teach every inch of my body!"

name: Iori
message: "...You never change, Asahi."

name: Asahi
message: "Hehe. When it comes to these feelings, I have zero intention of changing. If anything, they only keep growing stronger!"
She's completely back to her usual self. ...Maybe a little too back to normal.

name: Asahi
message: "Come to think of it, the first time we made love was back when you were still a student at this academy, Iori-sensei..."

name: Iori
message: "Don't rephrase 'training' into something weird!"

name: Asahi
message: "Even so, that was when I fell in love with you, Iori-sensei, and before I knew it, Jindou lessons became lessons of passion..."

name: Iori
message: "We haven't done anything yet!"

name: Asahi
message: 「……Not yet?」

name: Iori
message: "Ugh... N-No, that was just a figure of speech..."
Asahi stared straight into my face with total intensity. Dodging her gaze, I scrambled to play it off.
She kept doggedly chasing my eyes as I looked away... before finally giving up and stepping back slowly.
Instead, she hit me with another question.

name: Asahi
message: "By the way, you remember the first time I confessed to you, Iori-sensei, don't you?"

name: Iori
message: "Huh? Yeah... of course I do."

name: Asahi
message: "And do you also remember what you said when you turned me down?"

name: Iori
message: "What I said? Let's see... 'If I'm still single when you grow up, Asahi,' wasn't it...?"

name: Asahi
message: "Hehe. I'm glad you remembered."

name: Iori
message: "Why bring that up now?"

name: Asahi
message: "Those conditions... they're all met right now, aren't they?"

name: Asahi
message: "I've grown up, and you don't have anyone else, Iori-sensei."

name: Asahi
message: "Which means right now... you'll accept my feelings, won't you?"

name: Iori
message: 「Well, that's……」
Back then, I hadn't said those words with that kind of solemn resolve.
Still, Asahi believed my words and stayed true to them. No matter what, I owe responsibility for what I said.
And above all else—
Coming to this academy and reuniting with Asahi...
How she threw everything she had into helping me whenever I was in trouble...
Asahi has kept loving me all this time.
Sure, her forwardness left me flustered plenty of times, but every bit of it came from how much she cared for me.
Falling for a girl like that was only natural.

name: Iori
message: (Wait, no...! I can't get swept away right now...!)
As long as we're teacher and student, I can't act recklessly!
I try to hold firm on that principle alone, yet looking into Asahi's earnest eyes makes my resolve waver.
While I'm desperately trying to resist—
As if sensing something in my expression, Asahi smiled softly and stepped slowly toward me.
Before I could instinctively pull back, she caught my arm and tugged me firmly toward her.

name: Iori
message: 「W-Wait a second, Asahi...！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Hehe... No, I won't wait. Please let me hear your answer, Iori-san.」

name: Asahi
message: 「For you, Iori-san, I'll cook every single day. Breakfast, lunch, and dinner♪ And after dinner, I'll let you eat me up...」
Her mind's already jumping to some weird places, but—
On the contrary, though, those words just gave me a glimmer of hope！

name: Iori
message: 「Th-That's right！ I'm starving！ Aren't you hungry too, Asahi！？」

name: Asahi
message: 「So you want to check my cooking skills as a final test of whether I'm worthy of being your bride.」

name: Iori
message: 「No, and you're already calling yourself my bride！ A-Anyway, come on, let's just eat first and calm down！」

name: Asahi
message: 「...Understood. I certainly can't let you go hungry, Iori-san.」
After some desperate persuasion, Asahi finally let go of me for now.

name: Asahi
message: 「Then, in answer to your request, Iori-san, I'll put my cooking skills to work♪」

name: Iori
message: 「...Just so we're clear, this isn't some final test or anything, okay？」

name: Iori
message: 「Mmph... This is delicious！」
Asahi came to my room and treated me to a home-cooked meal.
Every single dish is exquisite—once I start eating, I can't stop.

name: Iori
message: 「Nom, munch... You're amazing, Asahi. Not just Jindou, you've gotten this good at cooking too.」

name: Asahi
message: 「It's for you, Iori-san, so it's only natural. Every bit of seasoning should be just to your liking.」

name: Iori
message: 「You've even got that figured out...？ Well, it really is right up my alley.」
Asahi really does devote herself to me in every way.
Honestly, you couldn't ask for a better wife than her.
You rarely meet a girl who pours this much love into you, and that's exactly why I...

name: Asahi
message: 「By the way, Iori-san？ Sitting across from each other and eating together like this... don't you think we look just like a married couple？」

name: Iori
message: （Crap... Hearing her say that only makes me even more self-conscious...！）

name: Iori
message: 「N-No, isn't this pretty normal these days...？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Do you think so？ I think it's very much like a married couple...♪」

name: Iori
message: 「Urgh... Oh, more importantly, Asahi！ You've got a grain of rice by your mouth！」
Spotting another lifeline, I reached out while trying to change the subject.
I picked the grain of rice off the corner of Asahi's mouth with my finger and ate it.
All that's left is to brush it off as a classic klutz move and change the subject—or so I thought, but

name: Asahi
message: 「Iori-san...」
For some reason, Asahi was blushing shyly.

name: Asahi
message: 「For you to make a move on me first, Iori-san... My heart is pounding so fast...♪」

name: Iori
message: 「I wasn't trying to make a move on you！？」

name: Asahi
message: 「What are you talking about？ Doing something like that is nothing short of what lovers do.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Oh, though if we were husband and wife, being a little more forward and using your mouth instead of your fingers would also be...♪」
Saying that, Asahi sticking a grain of rice onto her own lips.

name: Asahi
message: 「Come on, Iori-san？ Whenever you're ready...」

name: Iori
message: 「Ready for what！？」
...After all that, we somehow managed to finish our meal without further incident.

name: Iori
message: 「Thanks for the meal. It was delicious, thank you.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Not at all, I'm glad you enjoyed it. I'll go do the dishes.」
Perhaps having a full stomach calmed her down a bit, because Asahi began cleaning up in a calm, gentle manner.
Even the deft way she handles it really gives off the air of a good wife.
Watching Asahi's back as she washes the dishes while humming to herself, I feel like there isn't a man alive who wouldn't imagine married life with her.

name: Iori
message: 「...Honestly, Asahi really is such a good girl that I'd want to make her my wife.」
Before I know it, those words slip right out of my mouth.
It was undeniably my true feelings—so much so that if I could, I wanted to confess to Asahi right then and there.
Forgetting our positions as teacher and student, with Asahi—
Before I realized it, Asahi had vanished from the sink.
And instead, I feel a presence right beside me.
When I slowly turn around...

name: Asahi
message: 「Iori-san... Did you really mean what you just said？」

name: Asahi
message: 「About wanting to make me your wife...」

name: Iori
message: 「Y-You heard that...！？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Iori-san, I... I...！」

name: Iori
message: 「W-Wait！ Calm down, Asahi...！ What I just said was, um, how do I put it...！」

name: Asahi
message: 「I...... can't hold back anymore！」
With a face completely worked up with excitement, Asahi pinned me down.
I reflexively resisted, trying to at least break free from this restraint, but—

name: Iori
message: 「W-Whoa, you're strong！」
Even though I put up resistance close to going all out, Asahi didn't even flinch.
Just like Asahi, showing off her superhuman strength...... not that I have time to be saying things like that！

name: Iori
message: 「A-Asahi, calm down......！ Right now, I feel like this is turning into a pretty bad look in all sorts of ways......！」

name: Asahi
message: 「I don't care！ I can't put up with being teased like this anymore！」

name: Asahi
message: 「I like you, Iori-san！ I love you so much！ I'm in love with you！ Please go out with me with marriage in mind！ Or rather, just marry me already！」

name: Iori
message: 「Th-That's why I'm saying wait！ Wait a second, Asahi！ I also, umm......！」

name: Iori
message: 「I really do like you too, Asahi！ I think a future like that is on the table too！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Iori-san...... Iori-san！！！！」

name: Iori
message: （Crap！ Swept up in the momentum, my true feelings slipped out too......！）

name: Asahi
message: 「I knew it, you were thinking that too！ I knew it after all！ I'm so happy, way too happy！」

name: Iori
message: 「No, I mean I am, but hold on a second！ For now, just wait a little......！」

name: Asahi
message: 「After getting me this excited, making my heart race this much, doing all this to me—there's no way I can wait anymore！」
Excitement, joy, happiness...... Asahi's face, packed full of nothing but positive emotions, came closer and closer.

name: Asahi
message: 「I love you, Iori-san！ I dedicate my entire life to you, Iori-san—！」
Those sweet, soft―looking, adorable lips pressed against my―

name: Iori
message: （......It got stolen）
Yesterday, just like that...... with Asahi pushing me right through it, my first was stolen away.
It's not like I hated it. In fact, it's even something I wanted.
Still, I never expected my— at a timing like that

name: Iori
message: （To steal my first kiss......！）
By the way, as for anything beyond that, Asahi showed restraint, as expected.
Or rather, Asahi told me, 'I want you to tell me your feelings clearly. Otherwise, I won't be able to hold back on going any further than this either.'
Because of that, I gave in and once again told Asahi how I felt—that I liked her.
And just like that, Asahi and I became lovers.
I had wanted her to wait, though after going this far, I couldn't really say we weren't lovers.
Besides, more than anything—after that kiss, I couldn't hold back anymore either.

name: Iori
message: （I know my willpower's weak even by my own standards... but since it's come to this, I've got to switch gears！）
Even if it was unplanned, it was something I'd wanted.
That's why my spirits are soaring, and that's why I have to pull myself together.
Without forgetting our positions as teacher and student, I need to keep my public and private lives strictly separate.

name: Iori
message: 「At least the Martial Festival is over and we're into summer break. If there were classes, what would the other students say—」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ah, there you are！ Sensei！」

name: Iori
message: 「Ooh？」
When I turned around at the call, Setsugekka was running over.

name: Iori
message: 「What's up？ Even though it's summer break. I gave you a training sheet for homework, didn't I？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I'll do that too, of course, but I want separate coaching besides that！ Even when there are no classes, please teach me！」

name: Iori
message: 「Ooh, that's a pretty admirable attitude. Since you're being so enthusiastic, Sensei's happy too！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yes！ So let's head to the training grounds right away！」
Saying that, Setsugekka hugged my arm and pulled hard.

name: Iori
message: 「W-Whoa？ You don't have to rush that much... or rather, things are pressing against me...！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ah, found you, found you...♪ I-iorin！」

name: Iori
message: 「Whoa！？」
Just as I was about to start walking, Ririmu suddenly glomped onto my other arm.

name: Iori
message: 「W-What is it？ What's wrong, Ririmu...！？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「What's with 'what's wrong'？ It's not fair if it's just Secchan, right？ I wanna get Iorin's personal coaching too♪」

name: Iori
message: 「Ririmu asking for coaching on your own...！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I lost at the Martial Festival and it's frustrating. So... hey, Iorin？ I'm okay too, right？」
With a somehow seductive smile on her face, she tugs firmly at my arm just like Setsugekka.

name: Iori
message: 「Hey, like I said, things are pressing against me...！ No, forget pressing, my arm's getting rubbed...！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Hup.」
This time, a weight of several dozen kilograms suddenly landed on my back.
And pale arms dangled limply over both of my shoulders...

name: Iori
message: 「Hey, what are you doing, Momiji！？」
Somehow managing to move my eyes and look behind me, there was Momiji, flaunting a slack, lazy expression.

name: Momiji
message: 「Hmm？ It's nothing special~？ I just got a little tired, so I figured I'd weight myself down on you.」

name: Iori
message: 「Don't use a person as a substitute bench！ And besides, Momiji, various parts of you are pressing right against me……！！」
For some reason out of nowhere, I ended up restrained by three students.
On top of that, softness was being pressed against me in all sorts of places, leaving me torn over whether it was painful or not and what on earth to do……

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Oh my, you're quite popular today.」

name: Iori
message: 「Ah, Keisetsu！ Help me out！ I don't know why, but things ended up like this……！」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I suppose so…… fufu. Since I am a member of Takamura Class too, perhaps I ought to deepen my bond here as well.」
Saying that, Keisetsu slowly approached from the front――！

name: Asahi
message: 「Fufu, nnfufu……♪」
Even just walking down the hallway, a smile couldn't help slipping out. My steps felt light, almost turning into a skip.
Still, it couldn't be helped. After all――

name: Asahi
message: 「At long last, I'm lovers with Iori-san……！！」
A wish of many years. Feelings I had kept yearning for had finally come true. That joy alone made me feel like I might ascend straight to heaven.
Even more so when I thought about the happy days ahead.
After all, summer vacation had started, so there were no classes. Having no classes meant I could monopolize Iori-san！

name: Asahi
message: 「Right after becoming lovers, getting to spend dense, intimate time just the two of us…… is it really okay for me to be this happy！」

name: Asahi
message: 「For that reason too, I need to find Iori-san quickly and have a private lesson…… wait, over there is……？」
What I spotted ahead of my gaze was none other than Iori-san. However……

name: Iori
message: 「I mean, why are all of you clinging onto me at once！？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I simply wish to receive instruction promptly！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I just wanna get some instruction too, ya know~？ Ahaha♪」

name: Momiji
message: 「I'm just using him as a bench.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Fufu, how curious.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Wai…… wait just a second, all of you！！」

name: Iori
message: 「Ah, Asahi！ Help me out！」

name: Asahi
message: 「What are you doing！ Please let go of Iori-san right away！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Eh~？ Isn't it fine？ He's 'our' teacher, after all~♪」

name: Asahi
message: 「That way of putting it…… could it be that my relationship with Iori-san is already……！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oh, you two became a couple, right? Congratulations！」

name: Iori
message: 「You already found out？！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Anyone would figure it out after seeing Asahi look happier than she's ever been before, wouldn't they？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Besides, we'd kind of already noticed that Sensei probably felt that way about Asahi too.」

name: Iori
message: 「You noticed...？！」

name: Asahi
message: 「So you're all hugging Iori-san even though you know about our relationship？！」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「That's one thing, and this is another.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Within the bounds of a student-teacher relationship, you shouldn't give special treatment to just one person.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Guh, well... Even so, you've never been this clingy before, have you？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「We're just overflowing with motivation, y'know？ It's not like we're doing anything bad, riiight？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Ughhh...！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Then I should have the right to hug him too!」

name: Iori
message: 「Wh—hey, wait, Asahi...？！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Iori-san, please catch me！」

name: Iori
message: <s38>"Nooooooooooo？！"</s>
I apologized for sending Iori―san crashing into the wall, so putting that aside―
In the end, even after that, the members of Takamura Class started seeking Iori-san out and clinging to him every single day.
Iori-san even put together extra self-training menus for everyone, so they shouldn't have any excuse to cling to him anymore！
They even tell such obvious lies like, "There's a part I don't get~"！
Keisetsu-san told me, "It's their way of showing they won't let you have the teacher side of him all to yourself," and I can sort of understand that, though.
Meanwhile, Ririmu-san was just saying things like "Seeing Iorin and Asahi freak out is totally hilarious！" though！
And sometimes, it wasn't even just Takamura Class—

name: Asahi
message: 「Iori-san！ ...Wait, Tennouji-senpai and Minamoto-senpai？」

name: Victoria
message: 「Hiii, Kuki-chaaan. What's up？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Well, I mean... what are the two of you doing with Iori-san？」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Ah, we just happened to run into him over there and got to talking...」

name: Iori
message: 「I was asking them about what kind of training they usually do. Shizuku-san in particular collects all sorts of data, so I thought it might be helpful as a reference.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I see, so that's how it was」

name: Shizuku
message: 「A-A-Sorry！ I'll be right there……！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Huh？ Why？ I still haven't talked enough, yo！ And I wanna hear Muragaki-san's advice too！」

name: Shizuku
message: 「True, but……！ Still, look, if we get in the way of their hard-earned alone time……！」

name: Victoria
message: 「There are four of us right here, you know？」

name: Shizuku
message: 「N-Not that……！」

name: Asahi
message: 「……Ah, no, I don't really mind. Still, may I listen in too？ Since I'm interested in Senpai's special training as well」

name: Victoria
message: 「Of couuurse it's fine, yo！」

name: Shizuku
message: 「A-A-Somehow, sorry……？」
It's nice that these two aren't all clingy like Takamura Class……but because of that, I can't just brush them off, either.

name: Asahi
message: （So I can't get him all to myself again after all……）
On yet another day――

name: Asahi
message: 「Ah, Iori-san……！」
This time I spotted Iori-san in the dorm hallway.
What's more, today all the members of Takamura Class are somewhere else, and Victoria-senpai and Shizuku-senpai are out too.
Which means this is――my chance to be alone with him！
Today's the day for that long-awaited, intense time alone together……！！

name: Asahi
message: 「Iori-sa――！」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Oh, Iori, you're here. Got a sec」

name: Asahi
message: 「Gyaaaaaaaaah-teaaaaaaaah！！」
With the momentum of rushing over, I slam my fist into the brother-like matter that suddenly appeared from the side.
Thanks to piercing his solar plexus with a surprise attack, the thing that looks just like my brother crumples over as if folding in half.

name: Asahi
message: 「Just the two of us, Iori-san♪」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Hold up, dammit」

name: Asahi
message: 「Hm, surprisingly tough, aren't you, mysterious inorganic matter」

name: Takahisa
message: 「I'm a living creature！」

name: Iori
message: 「Uhh……what are you doing？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Oh no, please don't worry about it, Iori. I'll finish him off right away.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Don't finish off your own brother！」

name: Asahi
message: 「What is it? You've been awfully noisy this whole time.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「'What is it?' is my line. Why did you punch me out of nowhere?」

name: Asahi
message: 「Because my brother was there.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Unconditionally...？！」

name: Iori
message: 「Hahaha, you two sure get along well.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「What part of this looks like we get along...」

name: Asahi
message: 「First of all, why are you even here? Outsiders aren't allowed in, and suspicious characters are supposed to be arrested.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Don't call me a suspicious character. I just had something to talk to Iori about. About none other than—Asahi.」

name: Iori
message: 「About Asahi... You mean...」

name: Asahi
message: 「W-What is it！ Don't tell me... you're planning to object to my relationship with Iori？！」

name: Takahisa
message: 「No, I don't have a problem with that. In fact, if it's Iori, I can rest easy. It's just—」

name: Takahisa
message: 「If you tie the knot with Asahi, that makes you my younger brother-in-law, right, Iori！」

name: Asahi
message: 「...What？」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Well, I figured I'd tease Iori about it! Like, 'From now on, you better respect me as your big brother!' and stuff!」

name: Asahi
message: 「...Maybe I should finish him off after all.」

name: Iori
message: 「Right now, I have no objections.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「I have objections！ Tons of them！」

name: Asahi
message: 「What on earth is that pathetic little scheme?」

name: Takahisa
message: 「My best friend getting married is already prime teasing material, and when it's to my own little sister, how could I possibly resist teasing him？」

name: Iori
message: 「For that matter, we aren't even married yet.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Don't tell me you're planning to dump my little sister？！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Please don't say something so annoying.」

name: Iori
message: 「Talk about getting ahead of yourself. Besides... wouldn't I be the older brother-in-law in the first place？」

name: Takahisa

Her superhuman strength hurt a little—though in its own way, it also seemed to convey just how she felt.
So I gently wrapped my arms around Asahi's body in return...

name: Asahi
message: 「Your body, Iori-san... it feels so comforting, it makes me so happy. Could we stay like this just a little longer...？」

name: Iori
message: 「Of course. If you get tired of hugging while standing up, we can sit in a chair or lie down on the bed.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Iori-san... I never want to let go...」
Asahi stood on tiptoe just a little and brought her face close to mine.
When I leaned in to meet her... it wasn't just our bodies pressed together, but our lips as well.

name: Asahi
message: 「……Sorry. It's completely morning already」

name: Iori
message: 「I'm the one who's sorry. I was so happy being with you, Asahi, that I lost track of time」
We were spending some laid-back time together, and ended up taking it a little too easy.
As a teacher I probably should've sent her back sooner, or maybe my feelings as her boyfriend just won out.

name: Asahi
message: 「For now, I'll head back to my room once. If we don't hurry, it'll be a huge deal if someone sees us after staying out till morning」

name: Iori
message: 「Haha, true. ……Well, we didn't do anything today, though」

name: Asahi
message: 「I wouldn't have minded anytime, you know？ More than that, I was waiting eagerly for when you'd pounce on me……！」

name: Iori
message: 「Pounce……！？ W-well, it wasn't really that kind of mood either, y'know」

name: Asahi
message: 「Fufu, that's true. It was kind of mellow and calm time」

name: Iori
message: 「Totally. Anyway, your private lesson is tomorrow, Asahi, so get plenty of rest today」

name: Asahi
message: 「As for you, Iori-san…… you had Momiji-san's lesson, right？ Is your physical condition okay going like this？」

name: Iori
message: 「Something like this is no problem. More than that, our time together mattered more anyway」

name: Asahi
message: 「Iori-san…… thank you. However, please don't push yourself too hard, okay？ Since it's no longer just one person's body！」

name: Iori
message: 「Don't rub your stomach while saying that！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Fufu, I'm joking. Anyway, I'm going back」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, goodnight」
Saying that all over again and waving lightly to each other――
Yet both Asahi and I just kept looking at each other without trying to move.
The reason…… is surely the same for both of us.

name: Iori
message: （Is it because we were together for so long？ Even though it's supposed to be just a brief moment, parting like this feels lonely……）
Even so, we couldn't stay like this, and when I somehow shook off that feeling and tried to go back to my room――

name: Asahi
message: 「……Iori-san, do you know？」

name: Iori
message: 「Huh？」

name: Asahi
message: 「They say a lover decides to get married when they feel lonely parting after a date or an overnight stay, you know！」

name: Iori
message: 「Marriage……！？」

name: Asahi
message: 「In other words, there's a possibility that right now can be called the best timing！」

name: Iori
message: 「W-wait a sec！ That's way too big a leap no matter how you look at it！」

name: Iori
message: 「We only just started going out, and we’re teacher and student to begin with…！ Well, okay, on top of that we are dating, though…！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Fufu, that’s the second joke today. Don’t panic so much.」

name: Iori
message: 「What, the second one… Still, it didn’t really feel like a joke on my end, so I got a little flustered.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I’m sorry. But honestly, in my heart, I can’t really call it all that much of a joke either.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Even if it’s a joke right now, I’m looking ahead to a future like that！」

name: Asahi
message: 「In fact, all my eyes can see is a future walking alongside you, Iori-san！」

name: Iori
message: 「T-That much… Well, it makes me happy that you’re thinking that far ahead, though.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Fufu, since it’s you, Iori-san, it’s only natural.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Well, I’ve stayed a little too long, so I’m really heading back this time. I’ll hold back the loneliness for now, too.」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah… I’ll manage to hold back too and do my best today as well.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes, I’m cheering for you！ Excuse me then, Iori-san.」
Giving a quick bow, Asahi jogged back to her room as if shaking off her loneliness.
I watched her back leave—and suddenly found myself lost in thought.

name: Iori
message: 「……Marriage, huh.」
A future like that, a future walking alongside Asahi
There was no way I wasn’t looking ahead to that too.
The next day—
Individual instruction ran on a rotation system, and this day was Asahi’s turn.

name: Asahi
message: 「Right there！ Hyaaaaaah！」
As if striking at an opening in my guard, Asahi lunges in like a flash of light.
And from a draw aimed at a vital spot, she follows up with a second strike on the return swing, targeting another vital spot even harder to evade
I parried it while forcing my body to twist

name: Iori
message: 「Good sword line… but still too soft！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Kyaaaaaaaah！」

name: Yorishiro-kun
message: 「Barrier Jacket has fallen below the safe threshold. Please terminate the combat simulation.」
My counter landed cleanly, and Asahi cried out and went down. Right on its heels, that system voice echoed out.
I released the tension in my body, shut down the combat mode inside me as well, and walked over to Asahi.

name: Iori
message: 「You okay, Asahi？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Haa, haa… I’m okay, thank you.」
When I held out my hand, Asahi took it without hesitation and stood up as if pulled up by me.
Looking understandably tired, her breathing is heavy, sweat is seeping onto her face, and her clothes are clinging slightly to her body from sweat.

name: Iori
message: 「Let's call it a day here. It'll probably start getting dark outside soon too.」
It had been hard to tell from inside, but before I realized it, night was nearly upon us.
Even though I had eaten lunch, we'd been going almost nonstop since morning, so I felt a bit fatigued too, understandably.

name: Asahi
message: 「As for me, I can still keep going, though……」
Having finished catching her breath, Asahi speaks up as if making a suggestion.
But I shook my head.

name: Iori
message: 「It's not just a matter of doing it for a long time. You do end up needing combat experience while fatigued and all, but we're not at that stage right now.」

name: Asahi
message: 「……Understood. If that's what Coach Iori says.」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah. Resting up properly is part of special training too.」
Nodding at my words, Asahi begins getting ready to head back.
Then, after I get ready in the same way, the two of us leave the training hall together.

name: Asahi
message: 「――Do pro athletes also end up playing matches without having fully recovered from fatigue, after all？」
On the way back to the dorms. As if continuing our conversation, Asahi suddenly asks.
Walking alongside Asahi, I nod to that.

name: Iori
message: 「Well, that probably happens sometimes. Jindou matches drain both stamina and mental strength just as they are.」

name: Iori
message: 「Still, like I said earlier, now isn't the stage to build that kind of experience. First is improving your performance at peak condition. And next is learning how to get yourself closer to peak condition.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes. Of course I know that. They even say the greatest pros are the ones who don't get injured.」

name: Iori
message: 「That's right. If you carry over fatigue and get hurt, it's pointless.」

name: Iori
message: 「……Come to think of it, Asahi, you're aiming to become a pro Jindou athlete, right?」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes！ There have been all sorts of twists and turns…… but that goal hasn't changed.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Not just for my brother's sake, but as my own goal too, I'm aiming to become a pro athlete.」

name: Iori
message: 「Those feelings are really important, and I think it's a good thing.」

name: Asahi
message: 「And for that reason too, I have to train even harder and become even stronger……！」

name: Iori
message: 「Of course, I plan to support you properly too！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Come to think of it…… what about you, Iori-san？」

name: Iori
message: 「'What about me,' you ask？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Your 'future'... might sound a bit strange to say, or rather, your own plans going forward, Iori-san」

name: Asahi
message: 「Still balancing the JSDF and teaching？」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah... that's right. I intend to aim for that as much as possible.」

name: Iori
message: 「Teaching was my dream, and I want to keep doing it going forward. Still, that doesn't mean quitting the JSDF feels right to me either.」

name: Iori
message: 「We still need to talk things over to see what shape it'll take, though... Just like now, I might end up in a position like a part-time lecturer.」

name: Asahi
message: 「So you mean serving actively in the JSDF while occasionally being called to the academy as a teacher?」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah. Though of course, it's settled that I'll stay on at the academy as a teacher until you and the others graduate, so don't worry about that.」

name: Asahi
message: 「...It just occurred to me, but if you aren't on staff as a teacher, wouldn't it stop being a problem for us to be lovers, or even husband and wife？」

name: Iori
message: 「If you put it like that...！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Hehe, I'm only joking. I want to be instructed by you, Iori-san, so I'd be disappointed too if you stopped being a teacher.」

name: Asahi
message: 「In fact, I can't even imagine being instructed by anyone other than you from now on, Iori-san！」

name: Iori
message: 「I-I think that's going a bit too far, honestly... Once you go pro, you're going to need a dedicated Second, after all.」

name: Iori
message: 「Of course, though, I intend to give you the very best guidance I can while I'm at the academy.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes！ I'm counting on you！」

name: Iori
message: 「Still... saying that when my own future is still uncertain makes me feel a little pathetic.」

name: Asahi
message: 「That's not true at all. Whether one is a teacher or a student, the future is always uncertain by nature.」

name: Asahi
message: 「If anything, watching you continue to press forward toward your goals right now, Iori-san, makes you the best role model we could possibly ask for.」

name: Iori
message: 「Hearing you say that makes me happy. ...Though, being cheered up like this by a student is also a little pathetic.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Hehe. Right now, I'm not your student—I'm your girlfriend, so you don't have to hold back. Feel free to let me pamper you, okay？」

name: Iori
message: 「Haha. I'm a lucky guy to have such a dependable girlfriend.」

name: Iori
message: 「Phew, I'm home.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes. Welcome home.」

name: Iori
message: 「For now, guess I'll wash off this sweat before dinner.」

name: Asahi
message: 「That sounds good. Oh, in that case, would you like me to wash your back？」

name: Iori
message: 「N-No, that's a bit much...」
As we were talking like that—it suddenly hit me.
Asahi standing right beside me, and the interior of my own room stretching out around us. Looking back and forth between them...

name: Iori
message: 「...You just waltzed right in！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Oh, you noticed？」

name: Iori
message: 「Of course I noticed！ ...Well, okay, I didn't for a second.」
Worse yet, I'd even said "I'm home" to Asahi.

name: Asahi
message: 「That just goes to show how natural it felt to come home to the same room together♪」

name: Iori
message: 「Ngh, well... No, wait, this is still really bad, isn't it？ Especially after what happened the other day...」

name: Asahi
message: 「Hehe, I know. I can't keep staying out until morning over and over again, after all. Today was just a little bit of playfulness—a lover's prank♪」

name: Iori
message: 「You really are one bold girlfriend, aren't you.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Believe it or not, I'm actually holding my feelings back, you know？」

name: Iori
message: 「...Yeah, of course I know that. Besides, I'm holding back just as much as you are, you know？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Hehe. Just hearing you say that makes me happy♪」

name: Asahi
message: 「Well then, I'll head home for tonight. You have private tutoring again tomorrow, Iori-san, so please get plenty of rest.」

name: Iori
message: 「Same to you, Asahi. Make sure you get some good rest and recover your strength.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes！ Good night, then.」
Giving a quick little bow, Asahi left the room with a light step.
And as the front door quietly clicked shut... I couldn't help feeling kind of lonely after all.
『They say a couple decides to get married when they feel lonely saying goodbye after a date or a sleepover！』—
Those words of Asahi's crossed my mind.

name: Iori
message: 「...Marriage, huh.」
And once again, I found myself thinking about it.
Morning—I woke up to the sound of a strange noise.
There was no way it was my alarm, and it wasn't coming from the next room either.
Without a doubt, it was inside my place. And coming from the kitchen, no less...

name: Iori
message: 「What is that...？」
Opening my eyes warily, I headed toward the sound, and—

name: Asahi
message: 「Oh, Iori-san. Good morning. Did I wake you？」

name: Iori
message: 「Asahi……！？」
Asahi was cooking something in my room.

name: Iori
message: 「Why are you here…… or rather, how did you get in？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Just through the front entrance, of course. The door was unlocked.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Honestly, Iori-san…… just because it's a dorm doesn't mean you should be careless, you know？」

name: Iori
message: 「The lock…… come to think of it, I feel like I didn't lock it.」
Yesterday, after Asahi went home――because of the loneliness, I'd hesitated to lock the door.
Thinking that maybe she could come back unexpectedly again.

name: Iori
message: （Pretty pathetic even to me…… I've got it worse than I thought, man）
I'm made to realize my feelings for Asahi all over again. Not that I mind at all.
Besides, because of that, Asahi really did come over out of the blue like this.

name: Iori
message: 「Even so, why are you cooking？」

name: Asahi
message: 「……Iori-san, I realized something.」

name: Asahi
message: 「For a future walking alongside you, Iori-san, we need Jindou training, of course, but another kind of training too！」

name: Iori
message: 「Another kind of training？」

name: Asahi
message: 「So to speak――bridal training！」

name: Iori
message: <s38>"B-Bridal training……！？"</s>
With a sharp crack, it looked like lightning struck behind Asahi. At the same time, a jolt ran through me too.

name: Asahi
message: 「So I figured I'd start with my cooking skills.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Besides, preparing breakfast right next to where your husband is sleeping feels so much like newlyweds, doesn't it……♪」

name: Iori
message: 「Well, that's true, I guess……」
In truth, even though it's a cliché, experiencing it makes my heart race and leaves me feeling kind of happy.

name: Asahi
message: 「So please stay seated, Iori-san. I'll bring it right over♪」

name: Iori
message: 「Then…… I'll take you up on that. I'll be waiting, Asahi.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes! Leave it to me!」
Once we finished breakfast and tidying up, it was about time to head out. Though going out meant private instruction.

name: Iori
message: 「Well, I'll be heading out soon…… are you going back to your room now, Asahi？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Ah, about that…… if it's alright with you, Iori-san, I'd like to do some cleaning in your room！」

name: Iori
message: 「Cleaning？ Wait... could that also be part of the bridal training you were talking about earlier？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes！ I wanted you to see how capable I am as a bride！ Oh, of course I'll deliberately skip cleaning any 'places where something is hidden,' so you don't need to worry♪」

name: Iori
message: 「There's no place like that！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Is that so？ I figured there might be teacher-and-student stuff, or childhood-friend-little-sister stuff, or things like that.」

name: Iori
message: 「How weirdly specific...」

name: Iori
message: 「Anyway, there's nothing to worry about, and if you're offering to do it, Asahi, I practically want to ask you myself. I'm counting on you.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes, leave it to me！」

name: Asahi
message: 「...Oh, and Iori-san. Take this.」
With that, Asahi handed me a small square bundle.

name: Iori
message: 「Is this... could it be a lunchbox？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes！ Actually, coming here to give you this was my original reason.」

name: Iori
message: 「Is that right... Thanks. I'm really happy. I'll eat it at lunch.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I'd be happy if it suits your tastes, Iori-san♪」
Having exchanges like this makes it really feel like we're newlyweds.
Asahi's smiling face looked even cuter and dearer than usual, and my heart started pounding, so...

name: Asahi
message: 「Well then, Iori-san, have a safe trip.」

name: Iori
message: 「Ah, yeah. See you later... I'm heading out, Asahi.」
Saying that, I—suddenly, gently kissed her.

name: Asahi
message: 「Mmph...！？ I-Iori-san...！？」

name: Iori
message: 「Ahaha... A bit cliché, I know. Like a 'see you later' greeting, sort of...」

name: Asahi
message: 「Iori-san... Iori-san made the first move... hwaaaaaah...」

name: Iori
message: 「A-Anyway, I'm getting going！ Take care of the rest！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Y-Yesh... hab a shafe triph...♪ Funyaaaah...♪」
Leaving Asahi behind as she slumped down with a melted expression
My face was bright red too, and I broke into a run as if fleeing my embarrassment.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hyaaaaaaah！」
From morning on this day, I was coaching Setsugekka.
I kept taking Setsugekka's strikes—without her going berserk—one after another.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hyaaaah！」

name: Iori
message: 「Not bad at all...！ I can really feel how much stronger you've gotten！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Heheheh！ It's all thanks to my daily training！ Even your face is turning bright red just from blocking it, Sensei！」

name: Iori
message: 「Guh... Please don't bring up my red face！ There are a lot of reasons for that！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Reasons？ I don't really get it, but... that means now's my chance！ In that case, today's the day I land a hit on you, Sensei！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Toryaaaaah—！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Aaaahhhh...」
The moment a loud grrrrowl rang out, Setsugekka lost all her strength and slumped limply to the ground. Gently sidestepping the Origami she'd swung down just in case—

name: Setsugekka
message: 「My face isn't wet, yet I'm so hungry I can't muster any strength...」

name: Iori
message: 「Come to think of it, it's almost noon. Let's take a break for now and have some lunch！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yay！ Fooood！」
Reinvigorated, Setsugekka sprang up and dashed over to her belongings.

name: Iori
message: 「Looks like you're already getting your energy back before even eating.」
Chuckling, I went to grab my own bento as well.
Honestly, I'd been looking forward to this too—after all, it was a homemade bento from Asahi！

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Luunch time, luunch time♪ Oh, you brought a bento today, Sensei？ Wait, did you make it yourself？！」

name: Iori
message: 「Haha. It's homemade alright, though actually—」
Saying that, I opened the lid of the bento box. Inside was—
...Hearts.
Well, no, there was food in it. There was definitely plenty of food in there, but...
Every single piece of it was shaped like a heart, there was even a heart drawn on the white rice, and to top it all off, the word "LOVE" was written across it in huge letters.
And come to think of it, the cloth wrapping was covered in hearts, too.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「C-Could this possibly be... a loving wife's bento！！！」

name: Iori
message: 「Loving wife？！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Way to go, Sensei！ A loving wife's bento！ Made by your wife！ A gift from a bride, drenched in love for her dear husband！ Which means you and Asahi-chan have already...！！」

name: Iori
message: 「Why the hell would we do that！？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Am I wrong？ Asahi-chan made it, didn't she？」

name: Iori
message: 「Well, yeah, that part's true, but...」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Then it really is a loving wife's bento！ Woo-hoo！ Oh, let me take a picture.」

name: Iori
message: 「Why are you taking a picture？！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「So I can send it to everyone！」

name: Iori
message: 「You're going to spread it around？！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Don't worry! I'll make sure it's only to everyone in Takamura Class! Oh, look, replies are coming in. This one's from Ririmu-chan. She says, 'Teach, you're totally gushing!'」

name: Iori
message: 「It's already been spread...！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Whoa, the replies are pouring in！ Momimomi says, 'You gushing fiend,' and Sasaki―sensei says, 'You Great Demon King of Gushing'―」

name: Iori
message: 「Why am I being treated like some demonic entity...」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oh, Kei-chan replied too. Let's see... She says, 'You should certainly respond to your wife with the utmost love, though impregnating her already would make things a bit troublesome！'」

name: Iori
message: 「Impregnating her...？！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Be careful, Sensei！」

name: Iori
message: 「Shut up！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oh, get in the frame this time, Sensei！ A two-shot with your loving wife's bento！」

name: Iori
message: 「Who takes a two-shot like that？！」
...In the end, I kept getting teased about my loving wife's bento for a while into the afternoon too.
Not that I felt bad about it. I was just embarrassed. Being teased like that meant they accepted us just as much.
Besides, the bento itself was genuinely delicious, and every bite seemed to convey Asahi's feelings.
All in all, I could safely call it a blissful time.

name: Iori
message: （Well, the sheer fact that it's a handmade bento from Asahi makes everything blissful anyway）
With those thoughts in mind, I arrived back in front of my room.
I casually paused for a moment, but there wasn't a sound coming from inside.

name: Iori
message: （Did Asahi head back to her own room already？ I don't think I left the place that messy to begin with, so it probably didn't take her very long）
Part of me even thought that if it was going to be like this, maybe I should have made more of a mess.
Anyway, as I opened the front door.

name: Asahi
message: 「Welcome home, Iori-san！」

name: Iori
message: 「Whoa, Asahi？！」
The instant I stepped inside, Asahi lunged at me, and I frantically caught her.

name: Asahi
message: 「I was waiting for you to come home！ Right by the front door, holding my breath！」

name: Iori
message: 「Why wait while holding your breath」

name: Asahi
message: 「It's a surprise！」

name: Iori
message: 「Sure, I don't mind」
Trading words while still holding each other, I glanced around the room.
At a glance, nothing major had changed. Yet every trace of dust was completely gone, and I could tell the place had been cleaned down to the finest detail.

name: Iori
message: 「Whoa... You cleaned it this thoroughly? Thanks, Asahi」

name: Asahi
message: 「It's for you, Iori-san, so of course！ Oh, and the bath and dinner are ready too」

name: Iori
message: 「Even that much... You're amazing, Asahi. You said you needed bridal training, but it's like you've already graduated」

name: Asahi
message: 「Hearing you say that makes me so happy♪」

name: Asahi
message: 「Though I suppose you could say I've already been doing bridal training」

name: Iori
message: 「What do you mean？」

name: Asahi
message: 「I mean, from the very day I first met you, Iori―san―that's when my bridal training began！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Cooking, cleaning, laundry—I've worked hard at all of it while dreaming of a future with you, Iori-san！」

name: Iori
message: 「Haha. You're practically a veteran bride already. That's reassuring」

name: Asahi
message: 「It's all for you, Iori-san, so even after we're married, please leave every bit of the housework to me♪」

name: Iori
message: 「Every bit, huh... I really appreciate the offer, but wouldn't that be too much for you, Asahi？」

name: Iori
message: 「Once you become a pro Jindou athlete, you'll be busy with that too, so let's split whatever I can help with」

name: Asahi
message: 「No, I won't allow it！」

name: Iori
message: 「An instant answer...？！」

name: Asahi
message: 「If we're talking about hard work, you're juggling being both a teacher and in the Self-Defense Forces, Iori-san. I'll aim to balance Jindou and being a housewife too！」

name: Iori
message: 「You don't have to push yourself that hard...」

name: Asahi
message: 「And above all―I want you to depend on my care to live, Iori―san！」

name: Iori
message: 「That sounds kind of dangerous...！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Don't worry. I won't get that unhinged」
Does that mean she'll get a little unhinged, I wondered... though I decided not to ask.
Anyway, pulling myself together.

name: Iori
message: 「Well, for now... since you went to the trouble of getting everything ready, I think I'll take a bath first」

name: Asahi
message: 「Ah, yes！ Understood！」
Nodding as she said that—
Yet Asahi kept clinging to me, fidgeting for some reason as she looked up into my face.

name: Asahi
message: 「Um... Iori-san, you just got home, didn't you？」

name: Iori
message: 「Huh？ Well, yeah, I did.」
